meta.title: Microduck
meta.scope: 官方模型参考 · qpos0；不等同 alpha 实机配置或工程验收

source_registry.scope: captured source bytes, paths and digests
source_registry.description: captured source bytes, paths and digests

source_model_projection.scope: frozen Microduck MJCF visual model at qpos0
source_model_projection.description: frozen Microduck MJCF visual model at qpos0

hardware_knowledge.scope: source geometry, finite pin/housing reference-pair location evidence and separately identified unverified connector alternatives; retention remains unknown
hardware_knowledge.description: source geometry, finite pin/housing reference-pair location evidence and separately identified unverified connector alternatives; retention remains unknown

mechanical_validation.scope: no confirmed interface connection, retaining, motion constraint, assembly path or mechanical success is published
mechanical_validation.description: no confirmed interface connection, retaining, motion constraint, assembly path or mechanical success is published

engineering_validation.scope: materials, tolerances, manufacturing and load acceptance not established
engineering_validation.description: materials, tolerances, manufacturing and load acceptance not established

path_validation.scope: presentation explosion is not a disassembly or motion proof
path_validation.description: presentation explosion is not a disassembly or motion proof

training_data.scope: no training dataset, canonical multiview render or use authorization is published
training_data.description: no training dataset, canonical multiview render or use authorization is published

geometric_analysis.scope: finite arbitrary-axis cylindrical discovery with strict source witnesses, legacy finite geometry and per-instance raw mesh regions; unsupported structures remain open
geometric_analysis.description: finite arbitrary-axis cylindrical discovery with strict source witnesses, legacy finite geometry and per-instance raw mesh regions; unsupported structures remain open

interface_analysis.scope: connection reviews separate declared knowledge from project-inferred roles and manufacturer-general examples; no complete physical interface qualification
interface_analysis.description: connection reviews separate declared knowledge from project-inferred roles and manufacturer-general examples; no complete physical interface qualification

connection_candidates.scope: raw geometry observations are not qualified interfaces or mechanism-level connection candidates
connection_candidates.description: raw geometry observations are not qualified interfaces or mechanism-level connection candidates

reference_mounting.scope: supplied standard-assembly assertions checked against the frozen source placements and mapped site axes; no executed engagement is published
reference_mounting.description: supplied standard-assembly assertions checked against the frozen source placements and mapped site axes; no executed engagement is published

connection_review.scope: source-pose pin/housing fits support installation-location inference only; outer circular openings and manufacturer-general illustrations do not establish retaining roles
connection_review.description: source-pose pin/housing fits support installation-location inference only; outer circular openings and manufacturer-general illustrations do not establish retaining roles

supplemental_components.scope: reference connector schematics use explicit through-bracket hypotheses with independently checked finite entrance, head seat, shaft direction and target coverage; actual installation side, thread, continuous path and retention remain unverified
supplemental_components.description: reference connector schematics use explicit through-bracket hypotheses with independently checked finite entrance, head seat, shaft direction and target coverage; actual installation side, thread, continuous path and retention remain unverified

structure_investigation.scope: every source Part and mesh normal region is inventoried before functional interpretation; unknown function has explicit evidence gaps and next actions
structure_investigation.description: every source Part and mesh normal region is inventoried before functional interpretation; unknown function has explicit evidence gaps and next actions

independent_review.scope: locked source-SHA-bound independent annotations establish expected sample features; automatic screening is distinct from completed region review
independent_review.description: locked source-SHA-bound independent annotations establish expected sample features; automatic screening is distinct from completed region review

installation_hypotheses.scope: frozen completed research, source-bound finite counterpart geometry, dimensional complementarity and evidence support bounded mechanism hypotheses; no actual retaining or engineering confirmation
installation_hypotheses.description: frozen completed research, source-bound finite counterpart geometry, dimensional complementarity and evidence support bounded mechanism hypotheses; no actual retaining or engineering confirmation
